about: Every command a user can run, kept complete by tests/test_feature_map.py. Upper-case words in a command are placeholders.

features.name: Extract TLE history from the tle-archive git history
features.description: Pulls the TLE history of chosen objects out of the OndroNR/tle-archive git history, 2021-2023.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.extract_tle_archive --out DIR --norad ID [--norad ID ...] [--name-regex REGEX]
inputs: the OndroNR/tle-archive GitHub repository, cloned by the job
NORAD ids or an object-name regex

features.name: Build the GEO-region TLE set
features.description: Picks every object in the GEO region from yearly full-catalogue TLE bundles and writes its TLE history.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.geo_belt build --source URL --bundle PATH_OR_GLOB [--bundle ...] --out DIR_OR_ZIP [--also ID ...]
inputs: TLE bundles as .txt files or inside .zip files
the bundles' source URL, recorded in the manifest
outputs: both in a directory or in one .zip

features.name: Add SATCAT entries to the GEO-region set
features.description: Adds each object's Space-Track SATCAT entry (type, launch, decay) to the GEO-region manifest.
inputs: Space-Track login in SPACETRACK_USER and SPACETRACK_PASSWORD
outputs: the SATCAT query cached under spacetrack/ beside DIR

features.name: Label GEO operating modes
features.description: Labels the operating mode of every GEO-region object in 30-day windows, 2021-2025.
inputs: GEO-DIR/manifest.json and GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle from the GEO-region set

features.name: List GEO station-keeping state changes
features.description: Writes one row per dated state change (relocation start and end, graveyard move, end of keeping, end of north-south keeping, burn while free) for every GEO-region object, 2021-2025.
inputs: GEO-DIR/manifest.json and GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle from the GEO-region set (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/geo)
outputs: SUMMARY-DIR/summary.json with counts per type and year (default findings/state_changes)
SUMMARY-DIR/events.csv when it is under 2 MB

features.name: Rank GEO objects by how far they break their own routine
features.description: belt reads every GEO-region object's element sets once and caches its held spans, daily longitude and semi-major axis and steps outside holds (with --as-of, also the state changes and holds rebuilt on data cut at the end of 2021-2024); score turns the cache and the state-change list into each relocation start's surprise in bits against the object's own stays and moves (end-of-life departures listed, not scored), a per-object rank, stay overruns, proximity flags on arrivals and the unrated list.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.routine belt|score [--as-of] [--events CSV] [--out DIR] [--geo-dir DIR] [--cache PATH]
inputs: GEO-DIR/manifest.json and GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle from the GEO-region set (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/geo)
for score: the state-change list (default findings/state_changes/events.csv)
outputs: score: OUT/rank.csv, unrated.csv, departures.csv, off_routine.csv, overruns.csv, flagged_arrivals.csv, belt_prior.csv and summary.json (default findings/routine)

features.name: Write the published dataset
features.description: Writes dataset/: the state-change events with object names, owners, types and departure scores, one row per object with its rank or why it is unrated, the data card, and the evidence page for the top 30 of the rank; with --charts also one longitude chart per evidence object.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.jobs.dataset [--out DIR] [--catalogue MANIFEST] [--charts] [--geo-dir DIR] [--cache PATH]
inputs: findings/state_changes, findings/state_injection, findings/state_audit_fresh and findings/routine result files
names, owners and types from OUT/objects.csv, or from a GEO-region manifest.json with SATCAT entries given as --catalogue
for --charts: GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/geo) and the belt cache (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/routine/belt.pkl)

features.name: Compare GEO modes with ESA's classification
features.description: Prints, per ESA 2019 class, how many objects have the matching mode in early 2021.
inputs: pdftotext output of ESA's Classification of Geosynchronous Objects, Issue 21
segments.csv from the GEO modes job

features.name: Fetch element sets for the labelled objects
features.description: Fetches Space-Track gp_history for 2021-2025 for each object added in groundtruth/splits.json.
inputs: Space-Track login in SPACETRACK_USER and SPACETRACK_PASSWORD
outputs: counts and file sizes on stdout

features.name: Write the labelled-objects table
features.description: Writes groundtruth/objects.md, one row per labelled object with its burn and element-set counts.
inputs: cached Space-Track gp_history files in TLE-DIR

features.name: Draw the belt relocation chart
features.description: Draws every relocation and graveyard move in the belt's state-change list as date against longitude, one line per move from its start to its end.
inputs: an events CSV from the state changes job (default findings/state_changes/events.csv)

features.name: Write the feature map
features.description: Writes docs/features.md from features.json, grouped into data jobs, analyses, evaluations and tools.

features.name: Detector evaluation
features.description: Scores the step detector per regime (GEO, IGSO, ISS) against fixed periods and objects, with the GEO east-west and ISS recall guardrails.
features.command: python -m harness.evals.detector --split SPLIT [--final] [--data-dir DIR] [--settings JSON] [--truth-dir DIR] [--out JSON]

features.name: GEO mode events evaluation
features.description: Scores the GEO mode layer against a cited list of real GEO events: whether each event's mode change appears within 45 days, and how many days off it is.

features.name: GEO state changes evaluation
features.description: Scores dated state changes against the cited list of real GEO events (recall and date error per split and type) and counts false events on QZS-3, QZS-6 and Fengyun-2H while their logs show them on station; --final adds the holdout Fengyun-2F and Fengyun-4A, run once.
features.command: python -m harness.evals.state_changes [--split dev|all] [--final] [--events CSV] [--geo-dir DIR] [--out DIR]
inputs: groundtruth/qzss_manoeuvres.csv and groundtruth/fengyun_manoeuvres.csv for the on-station spans
groundtruth/splits.json, to skip holdout objects outside --final

features.name: GEO state changes planted-change test
features.description: Plants relocations, keeping stops, graveyard climbs and free burns into the element sets of held GEO satellites with a fixed seed, and reports recall, date error and extra events per kind and drift rate on dev and test hosts, plus false events on the untouched stretches.
inputs: GEO-DIR/manifest.json and GEO-DIR/<norad>.tle from the GEO-region set (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/geo)
harness/evals/state_injection_hosts.json, the frozen host stretches (rebuilt by --freeze from groundtruth/splits.json, groundtruth/geo_events.csv and the current code)

features.name: Hand audit of belt state changes
features.description: Draws the fixed 50-event audit sample from the belt's state changes, charts each sampled event, or checks and summarises the hand verdicts.
inputs: findings/state_audit/events.csv, the belt list as audited (from #55)
groundtruth/splits.json and groundtruth/geo_events.csv, to leave out holdout and test-event objects
for summary: OUT/audit.csv with the hand verdicts
outputs: sample: the sample as CSV on stdout
chart: one PNG per event, with neighbouring events from the audited list, and digests.json in OUT (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/state_audit)

features.name: Routine score checks
features.description: checks: off-routine rows on dead objects and on QZS-3, QZS-6 and Fengyun-2H while on station, cited relocation starts flagged and cited end-of-life moves typed, stability of the top of the rank across 2021 to mid-2023 and the rest, as-of reruns on cut data, and the cited irregular and steady lists when present; planted: three or four relocations planted on a fixed rhythm in a held satellite's element sets, then one more on or off rhythm, scored in bits; audit: the blind hand-audit sample of the top 30 and 20 from the middle, with one chart per object.
features.command: python -m harness.evals.routine checks|planted|audit [--split dev|all] [--events CSV] [--out DIR] [--geo-dir DIR] [--cache PATH] [--irregular CSV] [--steady CSV] [--charts DIR] [--share F]
inputs: OUT/rank.csv, departures.csv, overruns.csv and belt_prior.csv from the routine job (default findings/routine)
the belt cache from the routine job, built with --as-of for the causality check
outputs: audit: OUT/audit_sample.csv, OUT/audit_key.csv and one PNG per sampled object (default $ORBIT_WATCH_DATA/routine/audit_charts)

features.name: Calibrate the detector on the ISS
features.description: Picks the detector thresholds on 2021-2022 ISS burns and scores 2023 once with them.

features.name: Score the ISS holdout and cross-validate
features.description: Scores the frozen detector on Space-Track ISS history for 2024-2025, then runs leave-one-year-out cross-validation.
features.command: python -m orbit_watch.holdout --gp PATH --archive PATH --truth CSV [CSV ...] --out DIR
outputs: OUT/holdout_2024_2025/: detections.csv, events_scored.csv, report.json and a plot
OUT/cv_2021_2025/: detections.csv, events_scored.csv, report.json and cv_scores.png

features.name: Injection-recovery test on the ISS
features.description: Adds synthetic steps to the real ISS series in memory and measures recall by step size and false alarms on quiet stretches.

features.name: Score the detector on operator logs
features.description: Scores the ISS-tuned detector, and a GEO tune, against the QZS-3 and QZS-6 (GEO) manoeuvre logs.
inputs: Space-Track gp_history files, or GEO-region TLEs

features.name: Build ground truth from operator logs
features.description: Turns the published QZSS and Fengyun manoeuvre logs into the ground-truth CSVs, one row per source row.

features.name: Write the train and holdout split
features.description: Prints the train/holdout split of the labelled objects from its fixed rule, and writes it with --write.
inputs: the labelled objects and the split rule in orbit_watch/truth.py
